resources.string: Set Asudeh as your default SMS app
Asudeh isn\'t your default SMS app yet
Until it\'s the default, new texts won\'t reach Asudeh and you won\'t be able to send messages. You can still view your existing messages here.
Important messages, without the ad clutter
Asudeh sets ads aside so important messages don\'t get lost. No data ever leaves your phone, and no message is deleted without your permission.
For new texts to reach Asudeh, it needs to become your phone\'s default SMS app. You can switch back anytime.
